For an IR, the Workday Business Purpose section must include the venue names and the name of the student organization, department, or outside organization hosting the event, and the Description section must include the Event Status Report (ESR) number. Deposits: a cleaning and damage deposit is available for pick-up or refund three business days after the event, pending any cleaning and damage charges; production managers make three attempts by email to return it, and after 30 days the deposit is forfeited. Cancellations: for Bovard, the Trojan Grand Ballroom, Tommy's Place/Traditions, and outdoor events, cancellations must be made four weeks in advance, while TCC meeting rooms must be cancelled two weeks in advance, with requests sent to the venue's production office. Cancellations for tables and advertising requests must be in writing at least two days before the event. Cancellations made between four and two weeks before the event or meeting date may incur a late cancellation fee. Furniture: tables and chairs can be requested through Facilities Management Services using the FMS checklist on the Forms and Permits page, or at fms-evtp@usc.edu, with requests made at least two weeks before the event date; approved event services vendors named as alternatives are Bright Event Rentals, ELM, LA Party Rents, and Town and Country. Catering: USC has no exclusive catering contract; on-campus options include USC Hospitality Services and the University Club, and many outside vendors are university-approved, with approval status confirmed through Purchasing Services at (213) 740-2281 and new vendor approval handled by USC Hospitality Services at (213) 740-5956. Items left overnight in a venue incur an overnight fee and should be arranged when making the reservation; unapproved items are charged against the cleaning and damage deposit or venue rental fee as an unapproved storage fee. Rain: organizers worried about weather are advised to book a backup indoor location well in advance, and on the day should check in with the Trojan Event Services office, which will attempt to move or reschedule the event subject to availability; if the university must cancel an event for reasons beyond its control, including weather, loss of power, fire, terrorism, casualty, or labor strike, it is not obligated to refund rental or staffing charges or to reschedule. Day-of contact is the stage manager or house manager for Bovard, Tommy's Place, Traditions, and the Trojan Grand Ballroom; the production manager is the contact only before the event. Outside organizations are not approved to host events targeting USC's student audience unless they partner with a USC organization.

title: GSG Senate and Executive Board meetings: when and how to attend
content: GSG's published meeting pattern differs from USG's weekly senate. GSG senators meet monthly to address issues and concerns of the graduate and professional student population. Senate meetings are open to all, and the Senate page directs students to EngageSC for registration information rather than publishing a standing room or Zoom link. Committees meet on their own schedules, which the committees page states alongside each committee's expected volunteer commitment: the Finance Committee reviews RSO funding applications weekly, the Health Sciences Campus Research and Development Committee holds monthly one-hour meetings at which senators relay HSC-specific constituent concerns, the Presidential Strategy and Innovation Committee expects members to attend monthly meetings, and the Grants Review Committee works largely asynchronously, with a one-time virtual onboarding meeting scheduled around member availability and monthly application review during the first two weeks of each month. Meetings with Executive Board members are by appointment: the homepage asks students to reach out to an officer directly to schedule a time, and most officers publish an individual scheduling link next to their listing. Office walk-ins are possible during published business hours at either office: the main campus office at 3607 Trousdale Pkwy, SKS 410 is open Monday to Friday 9:00 am to 5:00 pm, and the Health Sciences Campus office at 1969 Zonal Avenue is open Monday to Friday 12:00 pm to 5:00 pm. Students who want to raise something at a Senate meeting are advised to go through the senator for their own school or academic unit, described as a direct bridge between the student body and GSG.
